sections.title: Действующая граница P09 по решению D125
sections.text: D125 (owner, 2026-10-06): P09 ограничена улучшениями кода и репозитория до выпуска. RC 1.0 не будет. P09.6/7/16/17 пропущены; P09.15 содержит только source lifecycle checks; P09.8 — code-quality review и обычный финальный CI D73. Не создавать sealed candidate, SBOM/first-release receipts, release DoD/scorecard, supported-release registry, operator packet или release qualification workflow/matrix; не менять версии, каналы, stability и release baseline. Исторические release/dod-map/qualification/candidate части досье и примеров не являются заданиями оставшихся items. Типизация, MSI95/90/75, API/SPI/BC/Golden и фактические проверки не ослаблены. Текущие item contracts и D125 имеют приоритет при противоречии старому runbook. Технические проверки migrations, facts, mutation parsers и behavioral regression tests сохраняются. D123 о каналах релиза не блокирует code-items; решение о каналах не принято. P08 readiness/design review остаются предусловиями; изменение плана не является разрешением на их обход.

sections.title: Type boundary examples
sections.text:
Before: $value = $payload['account']; return $value->id;
After: scalar transport account is validated with is_string/UUID before creating existing AccountId DTO; model return uses a typed Account view. For collection queries annotate Builder<Account>/Collection<int,Account> where true; no cast to invented interface.
Empty baseline:
```neon
parameters:
    ignoreErrors: []
```
Gate example: core ceiling=0 + empty baseline + max/strict/bleedingEdge/full src -> FOUNDATION GREEN. Moving same ignored error to @phpstan-ignore-next-line -> RED with file:line; omitted database/migrations directory -> RED; zero foundation with security still >0 -> foundation GREEN/all RED.
G4 frozen receipts: p08-rebase rows {key:"anchors.scripts/schema-gate.php",before_sha256:"<design>",after_sha256:"<closed-P08>",owner:"PLAN3.P08.3",ci_run:"<id>",ci_sha:"<final>",reason:"<verified diff>"}; wildcards RED. write-set exact rows {path:"phpstan-baseline.neon",before_sha256:"<pre>",allowed_change:"root debt decreases to0"} plus named own paths; it is frozen BEFORE measured edits. Pre records design_snapshot_sha/pre_source_sha/product_hashes/approved_deltas/write_set_sha; post records current_source_sha/diff_paths/current_facts and rejects changed non-owned file or package requires. Owned Pint/Rector/baseline changes→post0 without rewriting design snapshot; substituting pre digest or widening whitelist afterward→RED.

sections.text:
```json
{"schema":"corex-mutation-zones/1","zones":[{"id":"security","min_msi":95},{"id":"messaging","min_msi":90},{"id":"other","min_msi":75}]}
```
Runner expands the exhaustive precedence map in dossier §5, materializes per package config/coverage. 100 valid/95 killed/5escaped security ->95 PASS; 100/94 ->94 FAIL; 0 generated ->FAIL; 100/90killed/5timeout/5error does not become100, infrastructure errors FAIL; missing one source file ->FAIL. JSON log source/coverage hash mismatch ->FAIL before score calculation.
Invocation from wrapper: `vendor/bin/infection --configuration=<generated> --with-uncovered --with-timeouts --min-msi=95 --threads=1 --logger-summary-json=<report>`; actual report schema verified against locked0.35.6. No --ignore-msi-with-no-mutations. `--self-test` only fixture parsing; `--all` real acceptance.
Scoring examples are per package-fragment, not aggregate: security packageA 99%, packageB94% => FAIL despite aggregate95%. 20 pre-equivalence valid mutants/1 equivalent=5% allowed after independent confirmation; 19/1=5.26% RED. Declaration-only file N/A only AST+hash ledger; fragment with one mutatable method/zero generated RED. Recorded parse-error log + php -l failure exclusion; PDO connection refused/bootstrap/OOM error RED. Infection adapter/version matrix remains UNVERIFIED until P09.9 receipt.
G3 map example: packages/core/src/Modules/Internal/Gate/AllowAllActivationGate.php→core/security95; packages/core/src/Data/Internal/DenyDataScopeAuthorizer.php→core/security95; Modules/Contracts/ModuleActivationGate.php→security declaration inventory. Change mapping to other75 or omit any anchor→inventory RED. Empty Modules/Gate is not production coverage.
G5 DoD12 = named resume plus existing `deduplicates an identical external record across independent jobs before target apply` and `rolls back only the failed row savepoint and continues the batch`. Three nonempty JUnit reports, each unique expected case/assertions>0/0skips. Whole package exit0 with a missing named report→RED. Resume two batches across NEW executor must keep row1 applied once and start at stored cursor1; stale checkpoint0 denied.

sections.title: Export and operator examples
sections.text:
Core archive includes src/, database/migrations/tenant and explicit assets; tenancy includes database/migrations/root AND tenant; access tenant-cloud and operations budget from schema-sets.json also required. No shipped tests/vendor/secrets/repositories. Source bridge stability=unreleased is current fact, P09.6 explicitly sets stable before rc export and manifest allowlist removal; no rc with unreleased classification. This metadata enables BC enforcement and is distinct from Composer rc stability/channel.

Source full skeleton (replace public-dependency rows ONLY after D123 accepted):
```json
{"name":"axiomasoft/corex-full","type":"metapackage","license":"MIT","require":{"php":"^8.4","axiomasoft/corex":"^1.0@dev"},"minimum-stability":"stable","prefer-stable":true,"extra":{"branch-alias":{"dev-main":"1.0.x-dev"}},"repositories":[{"type":"path","url":"../core"}]}
```
Exporter removes repositories/branch alias/dev-only fields and pins ALL resolved cohort requirements =1.0.0-rc.1. Identity full stays optional for consumers and present in candidate; no extra.corex namespace/taxonomy fabrication. Source set must equal resolved public channel map and be complete, skeleton core-only is not final acceptance. Exported consumer stable root explicit requires {full: =1.0.0-rc.1@RC, core: =1.0.0-rc.1@RC, ...EVERY reachable rc library}. Removing a transitive root @RC allowance fails installation; do not lower minimum-stability. Changed full source dependency=exact rc fails source lockstep gate; exported ^1.0@dev fails release gate. Library type=metapackage with src/provider/schema fails typed metapackage guard.

core maps corex-core; transfer remains alive, no corex-modules identity. Native access channel / bridge channel / public set and split delivery mechanisms are OWNER QUESTIONS D122/D123, no hardcoded 19 or private verdict. Candidate zip repeated same committed source identical sha256; different hosted digest RED. Root validate/audit success with one consumer lock advisory RED. Old/source-less candidate receipt RED.
CycloneDX6.2.0 solve/help flags (--output-reproducible, --mc-version, --omit=dev) UNVERIFIED until P09.6 scratch actual clean-lock smoke records exact help and lock. Intended command is composer CycloneDX:make-sbom with reproducible JSON and explicit main rc version; sbom.py validates version/component graph and fails on missing help/unsupported flag, no silent dev-graph SBOM.
Operator packet CHECKSUMS.sha256 is UNSIGNED standard checksum text, signature_status=not-requested. Sealed source/cohort/tree/commit/ref/archive hash and operator identity UNASSIGNED until owner. Approval for exact publication remains absent. Hosted gate only accepts run ids for same source and four actual hosted cells, never local identical harnesses. New CLI wrong candidate input or stale evidence red in P09.6 smoke before P09.7 qualification.

G6 actual Octane receipt requires executed:true + real Worker/lock/version/source/actual JUnit events/cases, all4 cells. `forgetScopedInstances` model only or missing Octane receipt→DOD08 RED. octane-proof.py source-root prototype15 vs candidate archive smoke6/final7 are distinct; actual framework transport-handler scope is named honestly; auxiliary lock audited separately.
